name: Wash The House 🧼
desc:
👍 LIKE + JOIN GROUP 👍

You and your friends work as cleaners, but tasked with cleaning the dirtiest mansion imaginable 🙀
Can you wash, clean & fix the house?

🔁 Return items back to their spots!
💧 Power wash dirty objects and restore the beauty!
👑 Purchase upgrades to make cleaning easier!

🖥️ PC Controls:
E - Pickup Items
G - Drop
R - Rotate Power washer

🎮 Controller Controls:
RT - Pickup / Place
LT - Drop
Y - Upgrades
